title: Implement Global Average Pooling
description:
Implement global average pooling for channel-first feature maps by averaging every spatial location independently for each channel:

$$
\mathrm{GAP}(x)_c = \frac{1}{HW} \sum_{h=1}^{H} \sum_{w=1}^{W} x_{c,h,w}
$$

For an input with shape $(C,H,W)$, return shape $(C,)$. For a batched input with shape $(N,C,H,W)$, return shape $(N,C)$. The output must be a floating-point NumPy array.
